development_split: AGQA balanced train / Action Genome train
claim_boundary: development-only grounder qualification; never transfer evidence

metric_definitions.entity_candidate_pool_recall: fraction of evaluator-only gold object labels present anywhere in the answer-blind stable-track inventory
metric_definitions.typed_role_binding_fidelity: fraction of emitted query candidates whose requested role, typed-event role binding, track ID and cited evidence are mutually consistent
metric_definitions.cross_frame_dedup_fidelity: one minus residual same-predicate/same-typed-role event pairs with interval IoU at least 0.5, normalized by emitted typed-event pairs
metric_definitions.development_answers: opened only by the evaluator after grounding receipts are immutable

decision.if_pass: freeze implementation, models, frame budget, ontology, global threshold and fusion before a video-disjoint qualification cohort
decision.if_fail: do not allocate qualification; use only this consumed development cohort for question-blind supplemental-grounder development
